No average/min/max message-size reporting exists; only cumulative bytes+ops per stage.
counters.sessionResets is reported separately from ordinary traffic in /live.
/live is explicitly 'no payloads or identities'; traffic.snapshot() carries only byte/op counts.
undeliveredOutputBytes is exposed precisely to record bytes that could not be sent on teardown. [downgraded: RECORD without written record]
/live includes uptimeS (process uptime) but not an explicit 'observation window' for the traffic counters themselves (they are cumulative since start).
/live does not include an application version/revision field.
No troubleshooting procedure for unexpected outbound growth is documented.
No document or code addresses this item.
Measurement boundary (software estimate, excludes TLS/kernel/libuv/V8) and units (bytes) are documented.
No document or code addresses this item.
Codec size/boundary tests exist but aren't linked as counter-verification evidence in any handover doc.
4000-step randomized concurrent acquire/retain/release reconciliation test is the closest equivalent and passes.

W2 bulk output and 60-run measurements exist, but not framed/linked as bandwidth acceptance evidence.
Table names each optimization (binary frames, transferred buffers, cork writes, streaming seq, credit coalescing) with measured effect.
No document or code addresses this item.
H4 traffic model explicitly 'NOT RUN: no hardware counter to compare against' — a listed but not itemized unresolved assumption.
